name: 68512 · Lincoln, NE
findings: ZIP 68512 (Lincoln) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68512 (Lincoln) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
